flows.name: Discover the studio on the landing page
flows.goal: Understand what the studio sells and start shopping.

steps.userAction: The visitor opens the landing page.
steps.websiteResponse: The website shows what the Jaipur studio sells with featured photos and explains Jaipur studio pickup and courier with Rs 99 shipping and free above Rs 1,500.

steps.userAction: The visitor chooses Start shopping.
steps.websiteResponse: The website shows the public shop with pieces, photos, prices and honest remaining counts.

alternatives.websiteResponse: The website says nothing is available yet and invites the visitor to check back later.

flows.outcome: No data changes; refresh still shows the same studio intro, featured photos and Start shopping entry.

flows.name: Browse and filter the shop
flows.goal: Find pieces that are still available.

steps.userAction: The visitor opens the shop.
steps.websiteResponse: The website shows each piece with photo, price and remaining count, marking zero-stock pieces as Sold out.

steps.userAction: The visitor filters by product type and in-stock only.
steps.websiteResponse: The website shows only pieces matching the chosen type and availability with honest remaining counts and Sold out flags.

alternatives.websiteResponse: The website says nothing is available right now and invites the visitor to check back later.

alternatives.condition: No pieces match the chosen type or in-stock filter.
alternatives.websiteResponse: The website says nothing matches and invites the visitor to clear the filters or choose another type.

flows.outcome: No data changes; refresh still shows the same list with honest remaining counts and Sold out flags.

flows.name: View product glaze and size availability
flows.goal: Decide on glaze and size with honest availability.

steps.userAction: The visitor opens a product from the shop.
steps.websiteResponse: The website shows its photos, price, description and glaze and size choices with remaining counts per combo where sold-out combos cannot be chosen.

steps.userAction: The visitor picks a glaze and size.
steps.websiteResponse: The website shows how many pieces remain for that glaze and size and whether it can be ordered.

alternatives.condition: The product was removed in the meantime.
alternatives.websiteResponse: The website says the piece is no longer available and shows the shop again.

alternatives.condition: The chosen glaze and size combo has zero left.
alternatives.websiteResponse: The website shows that combo as Sold out and invites the visitor to pick another glaze or size that is still available.

flows.outcome: No data changes; refresh still shows the same product with the same per-combo availability.

flows.name: Place a pay-later guest order
flows.goal: Order chosen pieces for pickup or courier without signing in.
preconditions: At least one product with available stock.

steps.userAction: The visitor adds a piece with chosen glaze, size and quantity to the basket.
steps.websiteResponse: The website adds the choice to the basket and shows the basket with items, per-item prices and remaining counts.

steps.userAction: The visitor chooses pickup or courier, enters contact details and optionally a discount code.
steps.websiteResponse: The website shows the order summary with percent-off applied before shipping, Rs 99 courier fee with free above Rs 1,500 after discount and free pickup with studio address text, plus totals.

steps.userAction: The visitor places the order as pay-by-UPI-later.
steps.websiteResponse: The website creates the order with status New, reduces stock for the ordered combos, and shows a pay-later confirmation with totals and UPI instructions.

alternatives.condition: The quantity is empty or exceeds what is left for the chosen glaze and size.
alternatives.websiteResponse: The website marks the quantity, keeps the chosen glaze and size, and shows how many remain.
The website keeps the chosen values and offers to try adding again.

alternatives.condition: Name, phone or courier address is missing or incorrect.
alternatives.websiteResponse: The website marks what is wrong and keeps all typed values and the basket.
The website keeps all typed values and offers to try again.

alternatives.condition: The discount code is unknown, expired or over its usage limit.
alternatives.websiteResponse: The website keeps the basket and details, shows the code was not applied, and shows totals without discount.

alternatives.condition: The last pieces sold out before the order was placed.
alternatives.websiteResponse: The website says the combo just sold out, removes it from the basket, and shows the updated basket with what is still available.
The website keeps the basket and details and offers to place the order again.

flows.outcome: An Order is created with status New and stock is reduced; refresh still shows the pay-later confirmation with totals and UPI instructions.

flows.name: Owner sign up
flows.goal: Create the single studio owner account.

steps.userAction: The owner chooses to sign up.
steps.websiteResponse: The website shows an empty owner auth form.

steps.userAction: The owner fills in email and password and submits.
steps.websiteResponse: The website creates the single owner account and shows the signed-in owner workspace with products, glazes, orders and discount codes.

alternatives.condition: Email or password is missing or incorrect.
alternatives.websiteResponse: The website marks what is wrong and keeps the typed values.
The website keeps the typed values and offers to try again.

alternatives.condition: An owner account already exists for that email.
alternatives.websiteResponse: The website says the account already exists and invites the owner to sign in instead.

flows.outcome: Owner account created and signed in; refresh still shows the signed-in owner workspace.

flows.name: Owner sign in

steps.userAction: The owner chooses to sign in.
steps.websiteResponse: The website shows an empty owner auth form.

steps.userAction: The owner fills in email and password and submits.
steps.websiteResponse: The website signs the owner in and shows the private workspace with products, glazes, orders and discount codes.

alternatives.condition: Email or password is missing or incorrect.
alternatives.websiteResponse: The website marks what is wrong and keeps the typed values.
The website keeps the typed values and offers to try again.

alternatives.condition: The email or password does not match.
alternatives.websiteResponse: The website says the credentials were not recognized and invites the owner to try again.

flows.outcome: Owner is signed in; refresh still shows the signed-in workspace.

flows.name: Owner sign out

steps.userAction: The owner chooses to sign out.
steps.websiteResponse: The website closes the workspace and shows the public shop in a signed-out state.

flows.outcome: Owner is signed out; refresh still shows the signed-out state and the public shop remains visible.

flows.name: Track orders and mark packing progress
flows.goal: See newest orders first and move them to Packed then Shipped or Picked up.

steps.userAction: The owner opens the orders list.
steps.websiteResponse: The website shows orders sorted new-first with placed date, buyer, items, glaze, size, fulfilment, discount and totals including shipping math.

steps.userAction: The owner filters by New, Packed, Shipped or Picked up.
steps.websiteResponse: The website shows only orders with the chosen packing status, still sorted new-first.

steps.userAction: The owner opens an order for detail.
steps.websiteResponse: The website shows the order detail with buyer contact, items, glaze, size, quantities, fulfilment, discount and totals.

steps.userAction: The owner marks the order Packed then Shipped for courier or Picked up for pickup.
steps.websiteResponse: The website saves the new packing status and shows the updated order and list.

alternatives.condition: No orders have been placed yet.
alternatives.websiteResponse: The website says there are no orders yet and invites the owner to keep the shop stocked and check back for new orders.

alternatives.condition: No orders have the chosen status.
alternatives.websiteResponse: The website says no orders have that status and invites the owner to clear the filter.

alternatives.condition: The order was deleted in the meantime.
alternatives.websiteResponse: The website says the order is gone and shows the orders list again.

alternatives.condition: The chosen status is not the allowed next step for that order.
alternatives.websiteResponse: The website marks the status, keeps the order unchanged, and shows the allowed next step of Packed then Shipped or Picked up.
The website keeps the order as it was and offers to try saving again.

flows.outcome: Order statuses updated to Packed, Shipped or Picked up persist after refresh; list remains new-first with status filter.

flows.name: Add a product
flows.goal: List a new piece type with photos, price, sizes, glazes and stock.

steps.userAction: The owner chooses to add a product.
steps.websiteResponse: The website shows an empty product form with glaze choices and a photo preview area.

steps.userAction: The owner fills in the product and saves it.
steps.websiteResponse: The website validates and previews the photo, saves the product with its per-combo stock and shows it in the product list and the public shop.

alternatives.condition: A required value is missing or the price or stock quantity is not valid.
alternatives.websiteResponse: The website marks what is wrong and keeps what was typed.
The website keeps the typed values and offers to retry.
Nothing is saved; the website shows the product list as it was.

alternatives.condition: There are no glazes to offer yet.
alternatives.websiteResponse: The website says there are no glazes yet and offers to add a glaze before saving the product.

flows.outcome: New Product is created and visible in the public shop; refresh still shows it.

flows.name: Edit product and restock
flows.goal: Keep price, description, sizes, glazes and per-combo stock honest.

steps.userAction: The owner opens the product list and filters by type or stock state.
steps.websiteResponse: The website shows the owner's products with photo, price, type and remaining counts per glaze and size.

steps.userAction: The owner opens a product for editing.
steps.websiteResponse: The website shows the product's current name, type, description, price, photo, sizes, glazes and per-combo stock.

steps.userAction: The owner edits the product and saves the changes.
steps.websiteResponse: The website saves the changes and shows the updated product; the public shop reflects the new details and availability.

alternatives.websiteResponse: The website says there are no products yet and offers to add one.

alternatives.condition: The product was deleted in the meantime.
alternatives.websiteResponse: The website says the product is gone and shows the product list.

alternatives.condition: A required value is missing or the price or stock quantity is not valid.
alternatives.websiteResponse: The website marks what is wrong and keeps what was typed.
The website keeps the typed values and offers to retry.
Nothing is changed; the website shows the product as it was.

flows.outcome: Product changes are saved and the public shop reflects them after refresh.

flows.name: Delete a product
flows.goal: Remove a piece type no longer sold.

steps.userAction: The owner opens the product list.
steps.websiteResponse: The website shows the owner's products with photo, price and remaining counts.

steps.userAction: The owner opens a product to delete.
steps.websiteResponse: The website shows the product's details and remaining stock.

steps.userAction: The owner chooses Delete on the product.

alternatives.condition: There are no products to delete.
alternatives.websiteResponse: The website says there are no products and offers to add one.

alternatives.condition: The product was deleted in the meantime.
alternatives.websiteResponse: The website says the product is gone and shows the product list.
The website removes the product from the public shop; past orders keep their item snapshot.
Nothing is deleted; the website shows the product again, unchanged.

flows.outcome: Product is removed from the shop and stays gone after refresh; past orders keep their snapshot.

flows.name: Manage glazes and spot low stock
flows.goal: Maintain glaze options and know when a glaze is nearly gone.

steps.userAction: The owner opens the glaze list.
steps.websiteResponse: The website shows all glazes with remaining piece counts across products, flagging glazes with 5 or fewer pieces left as nearly gone.

steps.userAction: The owner enters a new glaze name and saves it.
steps.websiteResponse: The website saves the glaze and shows it in the glaze list.

steps.userAction: The owner chooses a glaze and renames it.
steps.websiteResponse: The website saves the new glaze name and shows the updated list with refreshed low-stock flags.

steps.userAction: The owner chooses Delete on a glaze.

alternatives.websiteResponse: The website says there are no glazes yet and offers to add the first one.
The website marks the field and keeps what was typed.
The website keeps the typed value and offers to retry.

alternatives.condition: The new glaze name is empty.
alternatives.websiteResponse: The website marks the field and keeps what was typed.
The website keeps the typed value and offers to retry.

alternatives.condition: The glaze was deleted in the meantime.
alternatives.websiteResponse: The website says the glaze is gone and shows the glaze list.
The website removes the glaze from the list; past orders keep their glaze snapshot.
Nothing is deleted; the website shows the glaze list unchanged.

flows.outcome: Glaze list with low-stock flags persists after refresh and guides the next batch.

flows.name: Manage discount codes
flows.goal: Offer weekend percent-off codes for Instagram.

steps.userAction: The owner opens the discount code list.
steps.websiteResponse: The website shows all discount codes with code text, percent off, start and end dates and usage limit.

steps.userAction: The owner fills in a new weekend code and saves it.
steps.websiteResponse: The website saves the code and shows it in the code list as usable by buyers.

steps.userAction: The owner opens a code, edits its details and saves.
steps.websiteResponse: The website saves the changes and shows the updated code list.

steps.userAction: The owner chooses Delete on a discount code.

alternatives.condition: There are no discount codes yet.
alternatives.websiteResponse: The website says there are no discount codes yet and offers to create one.

alternatives.condition: The code text, percent, dates or limit are missing or not valid, or the end date is before the start date.
alternatives.websiteResponse: The website marks what is wrong and keeps what was typed.
The website keeps the typed values and offers to retry.

alternatives.condition: The edited code text, percent, dates or limit are missing or not valid, or the end date is before the start date.
alternatives.websiteResponse: The website marks what is wrong and keeps what was typed.
The website keeps the typed values and offers to retry.

alternatives.condition: The code was deleted in the meantime.
alternatives.websiteResponse: The website says the discount code is gone and shows the code list.
The website removes the code; it can no longer be used by buyers.
Nothing is deleted; the website shows the code list unchanged.

flows.outcome: Discount codes with dates and limits persist after refresh and become usable by buyers.

flows.name: Correct or remove an order
flows.goal: Fix buyer mistakes by editing or deleting an order.

steps.userAction: The owner opens the orders list and filters by packing status.
steps.websiteResponse: The website shows orders newest first with placed date, buyer, items, fulfilment and totals.

steps.userAction: The owner opens an order for detail.
steps.websiteResponse: The website shows the order's buyer name and phone, fulfilment method, address for courier, items with glaze, size and quantities, discount, shipping and total.

steps.userAction: The owner corrects contact, fulfilment, quantities or status and saves.
steps.websiteResponse: The website enforces that quantities cannot exceed what is left, updates totals with discount and shipping math, adjusts stock counts and shows the corrected order.

steps.userAction: The owner chooses Delete on the mistaken order.

alternatives.websiteResponse: The website says there are no orders yet.

alternatives.condition: The order was deleted in the meantime.
alternatives.websiteResponse: The website says the order is gone and shows the orders list.

alternatives.condition: A required contact value is missing or not valid.
alternatives.websiteResponse: The website marks what is wrong and keeps what was typed.

alternatives.condition: The raised quantity is more than what is left for that glaze and size.
alternatives.websiteResponse: The website says only that many pieces are left, keeps the typed values and offers to use the available quantity.
The website keeps the typed values and offers to retry.
The website removes the order, returns its stock to the glaze and size counts and shows the orders list.
Nothing is deleted; the website shows the order again, unchanged.

flows.outcome: Order corrections or removal persist after refresh and stock counts reflect the change.

fields.label: Size selection

fields.meaning: Where the order is in packing and handover

steps.websiteResponse: The website asks to confirm the deletion and says what else will be removed with it.

alternatives.websiteResponse: The website deletes the record and what belongs to it.
Nothing is deleted; the record stays as it was.

assumptions.text: Sizes are Small, Medium and Large where applicable; a product offers at least one size and stock is tracked per glaze/size combo.
Product photos are simulated uploads: validated and previewed and kept for the session; MVP shows one cover photo per product and that photo is required to list.
Deleting a product or glaze does not delete past orders; orders keep a snapshot of product name, price, glaze and size.
If the owner deletes an order or lowers its quantity the freed stock returns to the glaze/size count; raising quantity follows the same honest stock rule as checkout.

questions.question: Do pieces use standard Small, Medium and Large sizes or custom dimensions per product?
questions.whyItMatters: Decides size options, product form fields and per-combo stock tracking.
questions.defaultAnswer: Assume Small, Medium and Large cover all piece types for MVP.
